name: app.mailsocket/mailsocket-mcp
title: mailsocket
description: Email inboxes for AI agents: create an inbox, then block until the OTP or magic link arrives.

environmentVariables.name: MAILSOCKET_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: mailsocket API key (ms_live_...). Create one in the dashboard or via POST /api/v1/agents/register.

environmentVariables.name: MAILSOCKET_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://dash.mailsocket.app/api/v1.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer ms_live_... (create a key in the dashboard or via POST /api/v1/agents/register)
